methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: A region-wide AI readiness initiative in Roanoke Valley signals intentional capacity-building beyond traditional tech hubs, suggesting distributed capability development if implementation moves beyond evaluation to deployment and training.

signals.title: News Flash Archive - NPD E911 Division implements Artificial Intelligence (AI) system on non-emergency lines - City of Norfolk (.gov)
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk's E911 AI implementation on non-emergency lines represents shallow but functional adoption—platform-delivered capability that requires minimal local expertise while modernizing public services,典型 of distributed but surface-level AI integration.

signals.title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia — site to be repurposed for mixed-use and residential development. - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: Amazon canceling four NoVA data center projects due to local backlash reveals infrastructure concentration creating community resistance rather than capability diffusion, potentially stalling even the region's depth advantage while other areas lack alternatives.

signals.title: Virginia governor orders statewide plan to address AI cyberattacks - StateScoop
signals.signal_reading: Governor's statewide AI cybersecurity preparedness order signals state-level awareness but lacks visible mechanisms for distributed implementation capacity—likely to concentrate defensive AI expertise in Richmond and NoVA government-adjacent entities.

signals.title: WVRIFA confirms Google is considering a data center in Roanoke County’s Wood Haven Technology Park - WSLS
signals.signal_reading: Google's consideration of Roanoke County data center represents infrastructure concentration following established patterns—physical presence doesn't guarantee local AI capability development unless paired with workforce programs and knowledge transfer beyond facilities management.
